description.fun: A soul that couldn't move on to the afterlife drifted on the wind until it got tangled up in dried grass, and became Bramblin. It tumbles across the wilderness wherever the wind blows it, with no idea where it's headed, and it loathes getting wet. Its cry recalls the whistle from The Good, the Bad and the Ugly, a Western filmed in Spain.
description.guide: A Grass and Ghost-type tumbleweed Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, said to be a lost soul tangled in dry grass. It evolves into Brambleghast after walking 1,000 steps with its Trainer.
description.tagline: A lost soul tumbling along as a tumbleweed

description.fun: A bigger, thornier tumbleweed that opens the branches of its head to wrap up prey, then holds on until it has absorbed all the life energy it needs before spitting the prey out. It wanders arid lands, and on rare occasions mass outbreaks of Brambleghast bury entire towns. It may draw on the Alicornio, a demon of Murcian folklore that hides in a tumbleweed to snatch souls.
description.guide: The evolution of Bramblin, a Grass and Ghost-type tumbleweed Pokémon that wraps up prey to drain its life energy. Bramblin evolves into it after walking 1,000 steps with its Trainer outside its Poké Ball.
description.tagline: A ghostly tumbleweed that drains its prey

transitions.how: Level up, after walking 1000 steps with it

note.text: Like Pawmo, Bramblin evolves only after walking 1,000 steps with its Trainer using the Let's Go! feature, outside its Poké Ball, then levelling up.
